sonnet.problem: This card tells the land shuddering at the roaring of a lion that devastates cities and devours men, and it carries a joke about shuddering when the oven timer goes off and he can't find his mitts. That puts a joke on a card about violence and destruction.
sonnet.rule: **Heavy moments.** A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.
